name: National Museum of Ethiopia
scope: The National Museum of Ethiopia’s permanent exhibition building in Addis Ababa, as photographed in September 2016. Includes the concrete gallery block, raised glazed floor, entrance canopy and stairs. The separate temporary exhibition building, grounds, facade artwork and interiors are outside the model.

originalReview.notes: Shows the permanent gallery building’s concrete fins, glazed lower storey, sloped plinth, projecting entrance canopy and steps. The separately authored façade artwork is not appearance evidence.

review.method: Exact published Qualla originals with native Commons SHA-1, pinned revisions and explicit CC0 dedications
review.notes: One exact September 2016 Qualla original by O.Mustafin was accepted under an explicit own-work CC0 dedication. A photograph centered on a separate facility and the façade artwork were set aside.
